Message Changed to make it more clear that players should not leave matches
Fixed to no longer be active in the End of Match Lobby
Players who leave matches or dodge lobbies acquire Leaver Points
Upon reaching certain thresholds of Leaver Points, two things occur:

Players see a message that explains their account has been penalized for leaving a match, and that leaving matches is bad. They must type "I Agree" that they will not abandon future matches to proceed past this screen.

Players are sent to a Low Priority Queue before their next X matches. This requires them to wait an additional amount of time before they will find a match. The time required to wait scales up with points acquired. Playing matches without leaving reduces the number of leaver points you have.
If a party is being delayed due to a Low Priority Queue party member, the party is notified.
Players are notified in the End of Match Lobby that a Leaver is being punished and has a penalty
This has been improved. Players are warned in-game for being AFK, and kicked at a certain time threshold.
If you are detected as AFK, you are punished as a Leaver with an additional punishment of Deserter so you cannot immediately join back.
Dodging a Ranked Queue results in the loss of 60SR
Dodging any Lobby grants Leaver Points
Additional updates to this system are planned for future updates

Shifted Tower shot prefire/postfire timing from 0.3s/0.7s -> 0.0s/1.0s

Previously there was a 0.3s delay before the tower would fire its first shot. This removes that delay to match parity with Smite 1. While it's not a huge buff to towers, it should make them feel more responsive when targeting gods that dive you under tower.
